explication: Tunix is a JAX-native LLM post-training library. A user selects a model and training configuration through the CLI, then Tunix builds training or RL workers. SFT directly optimizes model weights; RL generates rollouts, scores trajectories, batches them, and applies learner updates. Agentic RL adds multi-turn environment and tool interaction. Checkpointing and metrics support long-running TPU jobs. The graph emphasizes sampled orchestration and documented capabilities; several algorithm and model-family links are necessarily summarized because their implementations were not sampled.
